reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.contents: Bought annual pass, the app doesn’t work. I add milestones but nothing submits. Also all the workshops and courses are not included in the annual subscription. Activities seem repetitive every day and don’t match my child’s age.

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.contents: Helps with tracking and progressing towards milestones, and is great for finding activities to do and bond with baby. I’ve used it with my first born, and now I’m using it with my second and can genuinely say that it helps with development!

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.contents: The milestones listed are far too aggressive and seem to be designed to promote worry. See the CDC milestones app if you want something more practical. I didn’t end up finding the listed activities to be very fun or enjoyable which is what the goal was when I subscribed to this service. Sometimes less is more which appears to be the case with this app.

reviews.title: Cannot register
reviews.contents: I used this app for my first baby. Try to use it for my second. But didn’t let me register, asking for my organizational email. So wired! Is it a bug?

reviews.title: Helpful for Premature Baby Development!
reviews.contents: The BabySparks app has been an invaluable tool in tracking my baby’s development, especially since he was born prematurely. I love how the app provides daily exercises that I can do with him to support his growth. The exercises are easy to follow and well-explained, making it simple for parents to help their little ones thrive. One minor issue I’ve experienced is with the videos — sometimes they don’t play properly, and the app has logged me out unexpectedly, which can be frustrating. However, the content itself is fantastic, and I’ve been able to use the app to track my baby’s weight and milestones effectively. Overall, I highly recommend BabySparks to any new parent, especially those looking for guidance in supporting their baby’s development. It’s a wonderful, resourceful tool!

reviews.title: Amazing app
reviews.contents: I really appreciate all the ideas of stimulating activities to do with my baby! It guides me well!

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.contents: The app seems to randomly offer activity suggestions.  It would be so much more useful if it actually provided suggestions based on what milestones I’ve indicated that my baby has already achieved.  I have yet to see their algorithm work for me despite all the input I have already given the app.  Also, I can’t seem to figure out how to “backdate” my baby’s milestones so the app might think my baby just achieved something today when in reality he accomplished it weeks or months ago.

reviews.title: Should be free
reviews.contents: Baby care and activities for your baby and development should be free for all parents! to access the little bit that is in this app is great but there are far too many things locked! having a baby is expensive enough every parent should have free access to activities they can do with their children.
